entries.title: Find in a card scrolls to the match you step to, even when you step quickly
entries.body: Stepping to the next match twice in quick succession, just as the card changed, such as right after opening Find or as a new message arrived, could open the folded section holding the match and still leave it out of sight. Find now brings the match into sight every time.
entries.noPicture: The card looks as it did before; what changed is whether a quick step scrolls to its match, which a still picture cannot show.
